events.text: whats ISR again, plain words

Incremental Static Regeneration: the page is built once as plain HTML and served from cache, and after a set number of seconds the next visitor still gets the cached copy while Next rebuilds it in the background. So you get static speed with content that refreshes on a timer instead of only at deploy.

trailmix: htmx outerHTML vs innerHTML when swapping a table row?

Use `hx-swap="outerHTML"` with `hx-target="closest tr"` and have the Django view return a full `<tr>`. innerHTML would put your new `<tr>` inside the old one, and browsers drop or mangle a nested tr. With outerHTML the whole row is replaced, attributes included.

events.text: b-tree vs gin index, short version

B-tree: one sorted entry per row value. Good for equality, ranges and ORDER BY on scalar columns. GIN: an inverted index, one entry per element inside a value (array items, jsonb keys, text lexemes) pointing to the rows that contain it. Good for "contains" queries, slower to update.
